description: Source code for a class implementing a pseudo stack walker using address list, part of the Google Breakpad project.

classes.name: StackwalkerAddressList
classes.description: A class that implements a pseudo stack walker based on an address list, providing methods to retrieve context and caller frames.

methods.name: GetContextFrame
methods.description: Returns the current context frame based on the address list.

methods.name: GetCallerFrame
methods.description: Returns the caller frame based on the address list and the provided call stack.
